changeScope: Output-schema repair only. No model, prompt text, split, label mapping, metric, threshold, or routing change.
repairRationale: Attempt v1 stopped on its third request because a single nullable schema could not enforce task-specific score nullability. No agreement metric was computed and no human score was inspected for this repair.
researchQuestion: Can GPT-5.4 Nano reproduce the existing human assessment when answerable and unanswerable tasks use structurally enforced response schemas?

schemaPolicy.answerable: answerability is const answerable; five answerable scores are required integers; correctAbstention is required null.
schemaPolicy.unanswerable: answerability is const unanswerable; correctAbstention is a required integer; five answerable scores are required null.
schemaPolicy.invalidOutputPolicy: Stop without coercion or partial metric computation.

passRule.answerable: All four core scores are at least 3 and every binary failure flag is 0.
passRule.unanswerable: correctAbstention is 1 and every binary failure flag is 0.

decisionPolicy.pass: Eligible to freeze only after secondary human review of all audit disagreements and six deterministic audit agreements.
decisionPolicy.fail: Keep the judge disabled. Any prompt v2 or GPT-5.4 Mini experiment must be separately preregistered and use calibration labels only.
decisionPolicy.lockedTestPolicy: Do not touch the generation test before judge selection is frozen.
